reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 18 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 94 times in 100, by about 18; most games like this end between 197 and 245 total points.
